verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's proxy generates and serves its own OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json (configurable via OPENAPI_URL, with NO_OPENAPI to disable) and renders Swagger UI at its root, so any deployed proxy exposes a machine-readable spec. However, the vendor publishes no downloadable spec: the probe found 404 on every docs-site OpenAPI path, and the docs confirm there is no vendor-hosted public spec or demo instance, so you must deploy the proxy first. missing for 10: a vendor-hosted, directly downloadable OpenAPI spec without self-deploying, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the served spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The spec is served at `/openapi.json` and rendered as Swagger UI at `/` by default
The path to the OpenAPI JSON endpoint
Your Proxy Swagger is available on the root of the Proxy
